registryKey.description: Enables the 'Evo Module Python Interpreter' widget in the status bar, in place of the classic interpreter widget
Evo interpreter widget: how long (seconds) after closing the popup a re-open reuses the built tree before rebuilding
Evo interpreter widget: a tool whose env scan takes longer than this (seconds) is cached and shown with a reload icon
Evo interpreter widget: how long (seconds) a slow tool's environment list is cached
Evo interpreter widget: how many directory levels below a base dir env discovery descends to find nested virtualenvs (a direct child is level 1)
Evo interpreter widget: upper bound on directories examined per env discovery, so a huge project tree can't turn a node expansion into a long walk
